encoding.coastMask: uint8 base64, 1 = India land cell touching sea

meta.populationSource: Census of India 2011 district totals (nishusharma1608/India-Census-2011-Analysis), spread uniformly over GADM 2.x district polygons (geohacker/india), re-normalised so every state total is preserved.
meta.populationResolutionNote: Uniform density inside each district: cities are NOT concentrated. The specified WorldPop 2020 1 km raster was unreachable at build time.
meta.elevationSource: ETOPO1 as 10 arc-minute grid (fatiando-data/earth-topography-10arcmin), bilinear-resampled to 0.05 degrees.
meta.elevationResolutionNote: True resolution is about 18 km: valleys, embankments and river-bank heights are averaged away. Flood and surge extents are indicative only. The specified Copernicus 90 m DEM was unreachable at build time.
meta.outlineSource: Natural Earth 10m admin-0, India point of view.
